clips.title: The story
paras: The Warrior's Path is an introductory martial quest offered to budding fighters on Zephras Isle. Following instructions delivered through Rorian the Dayseeker, young warriors are directed to Blademaster Ren in the Thendal Village watchtower. Ren stands ready to offer combat instruction and discipline to those prepared to shield their people.

Upon returning to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Village after restoring balance nearby, aspiring fighters receive word that the settlement's blademaster has taken notice of them. Rorian delivers a crumpled note penned by Ren herself, asking the novice to seek her out directly. Elevated above the settlement within the village watchtower, Ren keeps an observant eye over both the island's borders and the recruits who may one day defend them.

Reaching the watchtower introduces the warrior to Blademaster Ren's philosophy of combat. To Ren, martial mastery is not simply an exercise in brute strength, but a vital duty to lead, endure, and protect in an increasingly uncertain world. She pledges her guidance to the recruit as they hone their skills, offering rigorous training as they grow strong enough to face the greater perils threatening their home.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.
Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So you've come for training, then?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.
Good luck, friend, may the winds guide you.
